bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $604，SAR 转为看空

read.en: Meta fell 3.3% on Nov 19 to $596.22, trading $595.79–630.01 on light volume (0.68x the 20-day average), its lowest close since Sep 2. It is below the 5-day ($619.9), 10-day ($624.5), 200-day ($629.1, falling), 100-day ($639.3) and 30-day ($653.6, falling). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram almost gone; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Nov 19 ($648.45), and RSI is 36.7.
read.zh: Meta 11月19日下跌 3.3%，收于 $596.22，盘中区间 $595.79–630.01，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.68 倍），为 9月2日以来最低收盘。股价位于 5 日（$619.9）、10 日（$624.5）、200 日（$629.1，下行）、100 日（$639.3）和 30 日均线（$653.6，下行）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图几乎归零；抛物线 SAR 于 11月19日转为看空（$648.45），RSI 为 36.7。

read.en: The $630.01 high faded and the close broke both the $610.2 and $604.5 supports, now resistance. Resistance is $605.1–610.3 (Nov 5–6 closes, Nov 18 low), then $618.9–620.8 (5-day, Nov 17 close, Nov 18 high) and $624.5–630 (10 and 200-day, Nov 19 high). Support is $595.8 (Nov 19 low), then $583.8 (Nov 5 low) and $577.1. A close above $610.3 would target $619–621; below $595.8, $584.

r.en: Nov 5 close $605.08; Nov 6 close $610.15; Nov 18 low $610.30, lost
